protocol.order: Four-condition rotating Latin order per round and item; common already-built group; geometry/bounds warmed; no explicit GC.
protocol.geometry: 27 actual tools at wear0, plus all19 runtime-loaded GLBs through glbinfo validation and real gltfRig/rigFactory buildPreview.
protocol.timing: performance.now around verbatim extracted production frame() function calls only. Closure supplies exact production camera initialization, backdrop scale target, and imported clamp. Builds, GLB loads, parent yaw changes, assertions, and rendering are outside timed intervals.
protocol.candidateLive: Full yaw and ±0.12 pitch support computed by verbatim sweepSupport(). Original had no separate live envelope.
caveats: Shared Windows desktop CPU; other tasks may contend and clock speed/thermal state are uncontrolled.
Node V8 CPU microbenchmark, not browser end-to-end latency, GPU timing, mobile timing, or FPS.
Repeated framing is intentional solely for samples. Ordinary preview update does not frame; source replacement does.
First-call timings are order-dependent diagnostics, not a controlled cold-start comparison.
Warm old Box3 path benefits from cached geometry boxes exactly as already-built previews do. Allocation and any incidental GC during candidate frame remain included.
